name: dsh-file-explorer
description: File management and editor add-on for the DSH web client's official right-sidebar Files page: create/rename/delete files and folders, copy workspace-relative paths, drag files into the composer as @path references, and edit text with optimistic-concurrency protection using the official shared highlighter.

scripts.test: node test/paths.test.mjs && node test/host.test.mjs && node test/client-smoke.test.mjs
